title: How to Prepare a Social Media Ad Campaign Before Hiring
h1: How to prepare a social media ad campaign before hiring
description: Prepare a social media ad campaign: goal, audience, offer, creative, tracking, budget, accounts and what to ask a paid social specialist.
intro: Paid social ads put your message in front of people on platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. A specialist can set up and manage campaigns, but results depend heavily on what you bring: a clear goal, a real offer, good images or video and working tracking. This article explains how to prepare, so that your advertising budget is used for learning and results rather than guesswork.

faq.q: How much should I spend to start?
faq.a: Enough to get meaningful data, but an amount you can afford to lose while you learn. A specialist can suggest a test budget for your market.

faq.q: Do I need professional photos or video?
faq.a: Strong creative matters a lot on social platforms. Clear, honest images or short videos often beat polished but generic ones.

faq.q: Who should own the ad account?
faq.a: You. Create or hold the accounts yourself and give the specialist access.

faq.q: How long before I know if it works?
faq.a: Allow a few weeks for the platform to learn, and judge results on cost per result, not clicks alone.

faq.q: What if I have no website?
faq.a: You can advertise with lead forms or messages, but a simple, clear landing page usually improves results.
